decisions.title: Behavior of `ReadOnly`
decisions.summary: ReadOnly keys in TypedDicts are read-only in the sense that they cannot be modified through the structural subtype, but not immutable in the sense that the underlying dictionary can still be modified.
decisions.rationale: The rationale is that ReadOnly should prevent redefinition in structural subtypes, but not prevent the underlying dictionary from being modified. This is to ensure that the type checker can enforce the read-only constraint without making the runtime implementation overly restrictive.

evidence.quote: This does not mean the items are immutable: a reference to the underlying dictionary could still exist with a different but compatible type in which those items have mutator operations.
